doc:
curves_merged.json: per-(layer, group) sensitivity a (KL = a r^2) over the MERGED sensitivity panels
sens/sens_panel.jsonl (panel 1: 21 rows, 24,341 tok) + sens/sens_panel2.jsonl (panel 2: 47 rows, 35,992 tok); disjoint
calib.jsonl records, never calib/panel.jsonl.  Same keys as sens/curves.json (alloc.py reads it unchanged), with:
  a_by_row      {row id: a} for ALL rows of both panels. Panel-1 rows: curves.json a_by_row (log-space fit of the row-mean
                KL / r^2 over panel 1's seed-0 r values: 0.05/0.15/0.35, gate layers 0/10/20/39: 0.01..0.4). Panel-2 rows:
                same fit over r in {0.08, 0.2} with seed-2 shared noise (same code and flags: --smooth --smooth-fp32
                --shared-noise --score-all).
  a_by_domain   {domain: token-weighted mean of a_by_row over the domain's merged rows} (weights = scored targets per row,
                n_tokens - 1 - image tokens).  This 'row-mean' estimator replaces curves.json's log-space fit of the
                domain-mean KL (the panels have different r grids, so their KL values cannot be pooled at one r);
                panel1.a_by_domain_rowmean vs panel1.a_by_domain shows the estimator difference on panel 1 alone.
  a_total       mean over the 8 domains of a_by_domain (equal domain weights, B-6), as in curves.json.
  a_tok         token-weighted mean of a_by_row over all merged rows.
  top_row       {id, domain, share}: merged row with the largest share of sum_rows n_row a_row.
  a_total_excl_top_row  a_total recomputed without top_row.
  panel1        {a_total, a_tok, a_by_domain (curves.json values, log-space fits), a_total_rowmean, a_tok_rowmean,
                a_by_domain_rowmean (row-mean estimator on panel-1 rows only)}
  panel2        {r_values, kl_values, kl_eq_values, kl_dom_values, a_total, a_tok, a_by_domain, resid, p_free,
                out_rel_mse, kl_top1pct_share, top_row, drafter_input_move, sources (sens_fit.py method on panel 2 alone),
                a_total_rowmean, a_tok_rowmean, a_by_domain_rowmean}
  All other per-curve keys (r_values, kl_values, kl_eq_values, kl_dom_values, resid, p_free, a2, a4, out_rel_mse,
  drafter_input_move, seed_a, seed_cv, kl_top1pct_share, fp8) are panel 1's, copied from curves.json.
meta: panel1/panel2 paths, rows (id -> domain, n, panel), n_scored_by_domain (merged), agreement (panel 1 vs panel 2).

agreement.estimator: row-mean on each panel (panel1.a_total_rowmean vs panel2.a_total_rowmean)

meta.objective: a_total uses equal domain weights (B-6) over merged rows; a_tok is token-weighted
